notes.title: The Idea Behind Rent a Girl
notes.content: [p]Rent a Girl was born from a simple question: [i]what if a relationship that starts with a contract ends up revealing something deeply real about who we are?[/i][/p][p]The idea came while reflecting on loneliness, self-perception, and the challenges of connecting with others in a fast-paced, often superficial world. Inspired by classic visual novels and modern coming-of-age stories, we wanted to explore how “fake” relationships can lead to genuine emotional growth.[/p][p]From the beginning, our goal was to create more than a romance simulator. We wanted to tell a story about vulnerability, discovery, and empathy. That’s why each heroine in Rent a Girl doesn’t just represent a different culture — she also represents a distinct emotional path. As you meet Lin, Seo-Yoon, Ana, Rin, or Katya, you’ll be challenged to listen, observe, and make choices that shape more than just the ending — they shape the journey.[/p][p]We’re now in the final stages of development. Recent weeks have been focused on balancing, refining the choice system, finalizing localization into six languages, and polishing the overall experience.[/p][p]The journey is almost ready — and we can’t wait for you to begin yours.[/p][p]Thank you for being with us so far.[/p]
